exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Maintain 45-degree incline bench angle. Press weights directly over chest.

exercises.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Keep spine neutral. Hinge backwards at hips until hamstring stretch is felt.

exercises.name: High Intensity Battle Ropes
exercises.instructions: Perform alternating waves continuously for 45-second work intervals.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Pull-Ups
exercises.instructions: Full range of motion. Pull chin over bar without swinging hips.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Rows
exercises.instructions: Drive elbows back while keeping chest upright.

workoutSplits.progressiveOverloadStrategy: Add 2.5kg to primary compound lifts each week when RPE < 8; prioritize 3s eccentric tempo.
workoutSplits.recoveryProtocols: Health Protocol: No chronic physiological limitations detected. Follow standard progressive overload protocol. Hydrate with 3.5L water & 8 hours sleep.

Barbell rows and weighted chin-ups with full scapular retraction.

Bulgarian split squats & hanging leg raises.

chatMessages.text: Great form question! Remember to brace your core with diaphragmatic breathing, keep your spine neutral, and control the 3-second eccentric (lowering) tempo on compound movements.
Your daily protein target is calibrated at 1.8g to 2.2g per kg of bodyweight. Distribute this across 3-4 feedings (30-45g per meal) to maintain continuous muscle protein synthesis.

For reported food sensitivity or skin flares, let us initiate a temporary 14-day elimination trial for that specific item. Please log your daily symptoms in the Symptom Diary so I can track your recovery.
